senses.definition: Used as a greeting or to begin a conversation
examples: Hello, may I speak to John?

senses.definition: The earth, together with all of its countries and peoples
examples: People around the world celebrate this day
The world is getting smaller due to technology

senses.definition: A particular region or group of countries
A procedure intended to establish the quality, performance, or reliability of something
examples: The test showed that the product was safe

senses.definition: To take measures to check the quality, performance, or reliability of something
examples: The theory has not been tested in practice

senses.definition: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid
examples: The study finds little evidence of overt discrimination
There is no evidence to support this claim

senses.definition: Evidence or argument establishing a fact or the truth of a statement
examples: You will be asked to give proof of your identity
This is not a proof, but strong evidence

senses.definition: To make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified
examples: Please verify that the information is correct
The system will verify your credentials

senses.definition: To indicate or show that one is not willing to do something
examples: I refuse to answer that question
She refused to accept the proposal
